gloss: mentioned above; as stated above; aforementioned

definitions.gloss: mentioned above; as stated above; the foregoing
definitions.explanation: Refers back to something that has been stated or described earlier in the same text, particularly in formal or academic writing.

examples.japanese: {上述|じょうじゅつ}の{通|とお}りである。
{上述|じょうじゅつ}した{理由|りゆう}から、この{提案|ていあん}を{採用|さいよう}する。
examples.english: For the reasons stated above, we will adopt this proposal.

examples.japanese: {上述|じょうじゅつ}の{実験|じっけん}{結果|けっか}を{踏|ふ}まえて、{次|つぎ}の{段階|だんかい}に{進|すす}む。
examples.english: Based on the experimental results mentioned above, we will proceed to the next stage.

notes:
Composed of {上|じょう} (above) + {述|じゅつ} (state, describe). Can be used as a noun ({上述|じょうじゅつ}の — the aforementioned) or with する ({上述|じょうじゅつ}した — stated above).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上述|じょうじゅつ}の{通|とお}り — as mentioned above
- {上述|じょうじゅつ}した — stated above
- {上述|じょうじゅつ}の{理由|りゆう} — the aforementioned reasons
- {上述|じょうじゅつ}の{問題|もんだい} — the problem mentioned above

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {前記|ぜんき} — aforementioned (similar register; slightly less academic)
- {上記|じょうき} — above-mentioned (very common in documents and forms)
- {前述|ぜんじゅつ} — previously stated (nearly synonymous; {前|ぜん} emphasizes 'previous' over 'above')
- {下記|かき} — below-mentioned (the opposite direction)
- {後述|こうじゅつ} — described later (the opposite in sequence)

REGISTER:
Formal academic and legal writing. Especially common in research papers, theses, and official reports. Not used in conversation.
